jobs.title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über Vestlane Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm. Du hast schon ein paar Jahre B2B-Marketing gemacht und willst jetzt Kanäle wirklich verantworten statt nur zuzuarbeiten? Du willst die Welt von Venture Capital und Private Equity von innen kennenlernen, ohne selbst in einem Fonds zu sitzen? Du kannst schreiben, denkst in Zielgruppen statt in Posts und findest es reizvoll, aus GwG und CSSF-Rundschreiben Inhalte zu machen, die Compliance-Verantwortliche tatsächlich lesen? Du betreibst Marketing mit KI-Tools und Daten statt mit der Gießkanne? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich! Als Marketing Manager arbeitest du direkt mit unserem COO zusammen, der Go-to-Market verantwortet, und in enger Abstimmung mit unserem CEO. Du übernimmst die Marketing-Themen, die heute auf seinem Tisch liegen – von Content und SEO über LinkedIn und Newsletter bis Website und Events – und bist nah dran an jeder Entscheidung, die unsere Positionierung bewegt. Kolleg:innen aus Regulatory, Design und Customer Success liefern dir Fachwissen, Grafiken und Kundenstimmen. Echte Verantwortung für eigene Kanäle ab Tag eins, kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung, keine Agenturschleifen. Dein Arbeitsplatz ist unser Office in Bonn, mit flexiblen Home-Office-Regelungen. Deine Aufgaben Content, der gelesen wird: Du planst und schreibst Blogartikel, Landingpages und Fachbeiträge zu KYC/AML, AMLR, Fondsregulierung und unseren Produktfeatures – auf Deutsch und Englisch, fachlich sauber, verständlich und mit Haltung. SEO und GEO verantworten: Du baust auf unseren bestehenden Rankings auf, entwickelst die Keyword-Strateg

jobs.title: Stage - Chargé(e) de missions IA
jobs.description: SOGECLAIR Training & Simulation conçoit des simulateurs de formation à la conduite ferroviaire, logiciels et matériels, autour de sa plateforme OkSyGen. La société compte environ 125 personnes réparties dans cinq pays : France, Inde, Australie, Canada et Royaume-Uni. Elle est engagée dans un programme de transformation, qui touche ses métiers, ses méthodes et ses outils. L'IA en est l'un des leviers. Des outils sont déjà déployés et l'équipe de transformation digitale du groupe SOGECLAIR travaille sur le sujet. Ce que nous recherchons, c'est une personne qui fasse le lien entre ces possibilités et le quotidien des équipes : comprendre les besoins réels, prouver la valeur par des cas concrets, et donner envie à chacun de s'en emparer. MISSIONS : Votre rôle : être le catalyseur de l'adoption de l'IA dans toute la société. Vous travaillerez en lien étroit avec l'équipe de transformation digitale du groupe. Comprendre le terrain. Mener des entretiens dans toutes les équipes (ingénierie, projets, commerce, support client, etc..) pour identifier les irritants réels et les cas d'usage à fort potentiel. Poser un cadre. Cartographier les données par niveau de sensibilité et proposer des règles d'usage claires : quel outil pour quelle donnée. Prouver par l'exemple. Concevoir et déployer des POC sur les cas d'usage prioritaires, définir les indicateurs de gain et les mesurer. Embarquer les équipes. Rendre l'IA compréhensible et utile pour chacun : démonstrations sur le travail réel des équipes, ateliers, formations. Construire la feuille de route. Élaborer une feuille de route IA couvrant toutes les équipes et la présenter au CODIR. En 6 mois : une feuille de route IA pour toutes les équipes, des POC déployés et utilisés, et un CODIR qui maîtrise réellement les possibilités de l'IA. Mois 1 : immersion et diagnostic. Entretiens dans toutes les équipes, cartographie des cas d'usage et des données, cadre d'usage proposé, indicateurs de gain définis et situation de départ mesurée.

jobs.title: Stage - Assistant(e) Recrutement (H/F)
jobs.description: Description du poste Au sein du service Talent Acquisition de SOGECLAIR, vous accompagnerez l'équipe recrutement dans ses différentes missions et participerez à l'ensemble du processus de recrutement. Vous contribuerez à identifier et attirer de nouveaux talents afin de répondre aux besoins des équipes du Groupe. Vos principales missions Participer à la rédaction et à la publication des offres d'emploi. Rechercher et identifier des candidats via LinkedIn et les différents jobboards. Réaliser des préqualifications téléphoniques et participer aux entretiens. Assurer le suivi des candidatures et mettre à jour les outils de recrutement (ATS). Échanger avec les managers afin de comprendre leurs besoins en recrutement. Participer à l'organisation de salons de recrutement et de forums écoles. Contribuer aux actions de marque employeur et au développement des relations écoles. Requirements Vous préparez une formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 en Ressources Humaines, Commerce ou équivalent, et souhaitez découvrir le domaine du recrutement. Vous êtes : Dynamique, curieux(se) et motivé(e). À l'aise dans les échanges et la communication. Organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et autonome. Force de proposition et doté(e) d'un bon esprit d'équipe. Une première expérience en recrutement serait appréciée, mais n'est pas obligatoire. La maîtrise de LinkedIn et des outils informatiques est un plus. Un bon niveau d'anglais serait également apprécié. Benefits Le Groupe SOGECLAIR est convaincu que la diversité et l’inclusion sont des éléments essentiels de sa performance et s’engage à recruter sans discrimination. Dans un souci de lisibilité, le masculin est utilisé dans cette annonce, mais nous encourageons les candidatures de toutes les personnes, sans distinction de genre, d’origine, de handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique. Work @Sogeclair ✨ : Un environnement de travail international et multiculturel 🌎 Des perspectives de mobilité interne Un apprentissage permanent : Sogeclair Academy 🎓 Un package

jobs.title: Video Editor and Motion Design Intern (H1/2027)
jobs.description: About Quandela Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 Description of the Team/Project You will join Quandela’s Corporate Communications team, helping bring quantum computing to life through video and motion design. Working with our communications and design colleagues, technical experts and external production partners, you will help develop our in-house post-production capabilities. You will turn existing footage, internally captured content and professionally filmed material into videos for LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, X and our website. Projects will range from short social clips to interviews, masterclasses, product explainers, and animated use cases. Your Key Responsibilities Edit videos from raw footage through to final delivery, including footage selection, storytelling, pacing, basic colour correction and audio adjustments. Create motion graphics, animated titles and visual explainers that make complex technologies and applications easier to understand. Repurpose longer videos into short clips, adapting formats, pacing and subtitles to each platform. Collaborate with the team on briefs, storyboards and visual ideas, ensuring consistency with Quandela’s brand. Incorporate feedback from communications colleagues and technical experts to ensure content is clear and scientifically accurate. Help organise footage, project files and reusable templates to make future production more efficient. Requirements Education & Background Currently enrolled in a programme in audiovisual production, video editing, motion design, animation

jobs.title: Software / Hardware Integration Intern (H1/2027)
jobs.description: About Quandela Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company’s unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient datacenters and scalability, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 Description of the Team/Project One of Quandela's priority is demonstrating fault tolerant quantum computing. We are widely known for our boson samplers, where one source can provide many photons, but for FTQC we will do spin-spin operations, mediated by photons with a dash of entanglement. So, instead of many photons from few sources, we need many photons from many spins. That means that someone has to ; every day, for months ; test many "spin-photon sources" together and determine whether the photons have adequate properties (single, indistinguishable, entangled), and other things. Where you will help, is making these measurements less tedious, by making some of it automated. For instance, by rotating waveplates by the right amount and in the right order at the right time. Upon your arrival the setup should be already built, but if we are behind schedule, you will probably give a hand on that too. Your Key Responsibilities Write instrumentation code that automates part of the process of a tomography/g(2)/HOM/lifetime/coherence time setup, and/or whatever is needed to make this setup run at the moment of the internship. Assess long-term stability, robustness and reproducibility through extended experimental campaigns. Implement automated methods for detecting and recovering from performance degradation. jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry. Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality. Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies. How we work Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents. Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate. At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work. End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it. In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication. Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly. Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues. jobs.title: Builder
jobs.description: Why this role exists Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel. Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started. What you'll do Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Sit with buyers and procurement leads, work out what actually costs them money, decide what's worth building, and ship it to production, with AI doing much of the heavy lifting. You're done when it drives revenue, not when it's released. Don't wait for a PRD: make the case, or skip the case and show the prototype. What we mean by Builder Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles. At Tacto, some of our Builders come from product, some from engineering, some from founding their own company. They all have one thing in common: they take a messy, unclear problem and own it from start to finish, whether it's a customer problem or a business problem. They decide what is worth doing, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When it works, they share it, we double down, and everyone gets better. We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.” What a week can look like A call or a plant visit with a procurement team to see how they really buy A prototype built with Claude Code or Cursor the next morning Shipping with a team of 1-3 Builders on one of the quarter's bets Who we're looking for Hungry, creative people who care about the result more than anything else.

We work closely with Technology, Engineering, Product and business teams to make security practical and effective, while ensuring our controls support the requirements of a regulated banking environment. Role Description The purpose of this role is to strengthen Allica Bank's identity and access controls by making access easier to request, safer to approve and simpler to evidence. The successful candidate will contribute to the day-to-day running of IAM services, including access requests, joiner/mover/leaver activity, access reviews, privileged access, RBAC, application SSO, and application onboarding. Alongside BAU responsibilities, they will identify and deliver improvements to processes, controls, and automation.

Mit rund 30 Kolleginnen und Kollegen planen und begleiten wir spannende und anspruchsvolle Bauprojekte – von der ersten Idee bis zur fertigen Umsetzung. Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen in der Heizungs-, Lüftungs-, Sanitär- und Elektrotechnik sowie der Gebäudeautomation . Dabei sind unsere Projekte so vielfältig wie unser Team: Ob Forschungs- und Laborgebäude, Gesundheitseinrichtungen, Wohnungsbau, Büro- und Verwaltungsgebäude oder komplexe Industrieanlagen – wir entwickeln technische Lösungen für unterschiedlichste Anforderungen. Was uns antreibt? Technik sinnvoll einsetzen, statt sie unnötig kompliziert zu machen. Wir legen Wert auf durchdachte, wirtschaftliche und energieeffiziente Lösungen und verfolgen dabei einen klaren Grundsatz: So viel Technik wie nötig, so wenig wie möglich. Als unabhängiges Ingenieurbüro setzen wir auf fachliche Kompetenz, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein kollegiales Miteinander. Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was wir gemeinsam erreichen, sondern ganz besonders auch, wie wir miteinander arbeiten! jobs.title: Product & Regulatory Counsel
jobs.description: Tired of meeting the product at the terms and conditions stage? Most product lawyers see the flow once it's built and the launch date is set. Here, you're on the whiteboard at ideation, so compliant by design is the plan, not the clean-up. And the stakes are real. Taptap Send moves billions of dollars every month across 100 countries, and is now building wallets, cards and broader financial products for diaspora communities. The job You'll advise on new licensing and products from first idea to go-live, and own regulator engagement across our markets. Shape products before they're built: review designs, UX, flows and terms against regulatory and customer-outcome rules, Consumer Duty included, while change is still cheap. Turn regulation into decisions: what's mandatory, what's prudent, and the alternative route that still gets it launched. Own the regulator relationship: across our markets, including new ones, and flag what regulatory change means for the roadmap early. Take products to new countries: localise what already works, with country leads and local counsel. Build the playbooks: templates that let Legal scale without adding friction. Why you'll want it Spend your time on the hard questions. You're asked to shape our roadmap and launches, and understand how to fit them to the relevant regimes Be a peer, with room to run. You'll join a flat team of regulatory and commercial lawyers, with real autonomy and a manager who trusts you. Make launches faster, not slower. Legal in the room from day one is how products here ship sooner. That's the whole point of your seat. Make sending money home cheaper. Remittances pay for school fees, rent and medical bills, and are worth more than all foreign aid combined. Cheaper, reliable transfers put more of that money in families' hands. Is this you? jobs.description: 283 – Directeur.rice des Finances Premier opérateur public européen de traitement et de valorisation des déchets, le Syctom, l’agence métropolitaine des déchets ménagers, est un acteur majeur de l'économie circulaire et de la ville durable. Au service de 81 communes franciliennes et de près de 6 millions d'habitants, le Syctom accomplit sa mission de service public avec pour objectif de faire des déchets une ressource. Une mission exigeante qu'il conduit grâce à ses 145 collaboratrices et collaborateurs et 7 apprenti.es, en lien étroit avec les collectivités adhérentes (Ville de Paris et 10 Etablissements publics territoriaux du Grand Paris) en charge de la collecte des déchets et l'ensemble des acteurs de la filière. Le budget annuel s’élève à 822 M€ et le Plan des Investissements 825 M€ d’ici 2030. Le Syctom traite et valorise chaque année 2,2 millions de tonnes de déchets ménagers dans ses unités de traitement innovantes (3 unités de valorisation énergétique - UVE -, 5 centres de tri, 2 centres de transfert et une future unité de Biométhanisation). Le patrimoine du syndicat, alliant performance industrielle et exemplarité environnementale, est exploité sous contrat par des entreprises privées ou des SemOp présidées par un.e élu.e du syndicat. Acteur responsable et innovant, le Syctom est engagé en première ligne dans la dynamique de transition écologique française. Il accompagne le développement de la collecte des déchets alimentaires, développe des solutions de traitement et de valorisation, agit en faveur de la réduction et du tri des déchets et s’engage dans la réduction des émissions de gaz à effet de serre (GES) liées à ses activités de transport et de logistique. La Direction générale adjointe Ressources et moyens (DGARM) pilote les moyens financiers, humains, informatiques, juridiques et logistiques ainsi que du fonctionnement de l’institution et des actions œuvrant à la qualité de vie au travail. Elle accompagne les directions opérationnelles au quotidien

jobs.title: Engineering Internship - Deep Learning for Infrared Thermography Antenna Measurements
jobs.description: THE POSITION ANYFIELDS measures antennas by infrared thermography: a thermosensitive film heated by the radiated field is imaged by an infrared camera, giving a 2D map of the electric field, nonintrusive and very close to the antenna. Two limits remain: the maps are noisy (dynamic range of 25 to 30 dB at best, 35 to 40 dB needed to retrieve side lobes and cross-polarization), and they are blurred by the response of the detector (film and optics), whose resolution is not explained by the theory. This internship develops physics-driven neural networks, trained without any clean reference, to restore the maps, and compares them rigorously with the conventional methods already implemented. Missions : Benchmark synthetic and measured datasets, reproduction of the conventional methods (wavelet denoising, drift removal, deconvolution, slanted edge). Estimate PSF of the detector: neural network constrained by the film heat diffusion and the optics, estimated from a few measurements; explain the gap between the theoretical (about 1 mm) and measured (4 to 8 mm) resolution. Compare with conventional methods. Implement Denoising by self-supervised deep denoising of the maps, quantified gain in dB towards 35 to 40 dB, ranking of the limiting factors of the setup. Validate by test whether the imaging resolves the individual elements of array antennas in the Ku and Ka bands, before and after improvement. Report on the retained methods. You will work at the crossroads of electromagnetics, imaging and deep learning, with the engineers of the Innovation team. Location: Toulouse (city centre) Start: As soon as possible Duration: 6 months Profile Bac+5 - Engineering school / Master in applied mathematics, signal and image processing, machine learning and/or electromagnetics Programming skills (preferably Python), experience with a deep learning framework Knowledge of inverse problems or infrared cameras is a plus Team spirit, proactive attitude and good communication skills in an inter

As our technology moves from development toward industrial application, building a robust and scalable supply chain is essential to our success. Your Role We are looking for a Procurement & Supply Chain Manager to establish and lead this function from the ground up. You will work closely with our Product and Engineering teams, Finance, Legal, and external partners to establish company-wide procurement standards, negotiate complex technical and commercial agreements, and build a supplier ecosystem capable of supporting our growth. Initially operating as a senior individual contributor, you will have significant autonomy and influence over how this function develops. As SourceLight scales, you will have the opportunity to expand the team, introduce new capabilities, and evolve procurement and supply chain into a fully established organizational function. If you enjoy building structure in a fast-moving technical environment, navigating complex supplier relationships, and creating the operational foundations that enable innovative technology to reach the market, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact. As our GTM engineering intern, you will run outbound campaigns end to end and help build the next layer: signal-based lead generation. You will also help us improve account scoring and build AI automations that take manual work off our sales reps. There is no textbook for this role. You will learn it the way we did: by building, shipping and seeing what works. You will also see first-hand how a modern B2B start-up operates day to day, with AI built into its workflows. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Procurement (Hard Home)
jobs.description: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure

jobs.title: Global Total Rewards Lead
jobs.description: Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance. The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog , LinkedIn , X , and YouTube . We're ~1,300 builders across 18 countries. We share context openly, including how pay works. We work across functions and borders, question defaults, and own our outcomes. Our People team runs on Dataiku too, with AI agents and automated workflows. The role Location: US, East Coast remote · Reports to: VP, People Foundations You'll own Dataiku's global compensation, equity and benefits strategy. The goal: programs that win in AI talent markets, are fair inside the company, scale across 18 countries, and stay financially sustainable. Our People function is lean and decentralized. You'll work directly with executives, Finance, Legal and the Compensation Committee, lead a small Total Rewards team, and have real autonomy. This is a builder role: you'll challenge how things are done today and use AI to reinvent how rewards work. What you'll do Set the strategy. Own and evolve our global compensation philosophy, balancing market competitiveness, internal equity and financial discipline. Lead pay transparency. Define our global approach and get the company ready for new rules, including the EU Pay Transparency Directive. Build the foundations. Evolve our job architecture, leveling and salary ranges, with rigor but without bureaucracy, and give managers simple tools to make good pay

jobs.company: Dipl.-Kfm. Hans M. Klein + Partner mbB
jobs.description: Menschen begleiten. Wege bereiten. Zukunft gestalten. Deine Karriere bei Klein und Partner. Als mittelständische Kanzlei im Herzen von Köln beraten wir mit unseren über 60 engagierten Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern vom weltbekannten Großkonzern über das ambitionierte Start-up bis zum Soloselbständigen eine vielschichtige Bandbreite an spannenden Mandanten. Was auf den ersten Blick wie eine klassische Steuerberatungs- und Wirtschaftsprüfungskanzlei klingen mag, ist bei genauerer Betrachtung vielleicht doch etwas mehr. Wir schaffen mit einem Berufsträgeranteil von 40 % beste Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für unser Team, profitieren täglich von einem internen Kanzlei- sowie einem zusätzlichen HR-Manager und sorgen durch unser von Wertschätzung und Vertrauen geprägtes Miteinander dafür, dass Flexibilität, Teamspirit und flache Hierarchien keine Floskeln sind. Kurz gesagt sind wir eine gute Mannschaft, die sich freuen würde, dich als neues Teammitglied in unserer Kanzlei begrüßen zu dürfen. Unsere nachfolgende Stellenanzeige ist deshalb auch eine Bewerbung an dich und hoffentlich der Grundstein für eine gemeinsame und erfolgreiche Zukunft. Aufgaben Tätigkeiten. Das passende Umfeld für deine berufliche Zukunft. Stellst du dir manchmal die Frage, warum du eigentlich Wirtschaftsprüfer und / oder Steuerberater geworden bist? Sicherlich nicht, um dich täglich mit administrativen und repetitiven Tätigkeiten auseinandersetzen zu müssen. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Strategic GTM Lead for Insurance in DACH : someone who has led client engagements at a top-tier strategy consultancy and now wants to build a market rather than advise on one. You will decide which insurers we go after and why, develop those relationships from first contact to signed partnership, and be the person senior insurance executives trust to think through how AI changes underwriting, claims and operations in their business. Our Account Executives close individual deals and use cases; you set the direction for the account as a whole. Most of your impact comes from account strategy, executive dialogue, ecosystem work with consultancies and partners, and shaping how Taktile shows up in the German-speaking insurance market. You will work closely with our Head of Insurance, Account Executives, Solution Engineering, Product and Engineering. jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy. jobs.title: Teamleider Electromagnetic Warfare (m/v/x)
jobs.description: Ben jij die ambitieuze Teamleider / R&D engineer die graag helpt om civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie en duurzaamheid? Wij zijn op zoek naar een teamleider voor de afdeling. Wat ga je doen? In een wereld waarin lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen steeds complexer worden, is het belangrijk om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen om de veiligheid en efficiëntie te garanderen. Binnen NLR werken we aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde aerospace systemen. We maken hierbij gebruik van software modelering en simulatie om het gedrag van complexe systemen te begrijpen en te optimaliseren. Onze expertise in hardware testen en operationele ondersteuning (OPS) zorgt ervoor dat onze oplossingen niet alleen theoretisch solide zijn, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar en robuust. De belangstelling voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) neemt toe, met de noodzaak om onze lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen te beschermen tegen elektromagnetische bedreigingen. We zoeken hierom een teamleider binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electronic Warfare (ASEW) Als teamleider EW zal je leiding geven aan een team van professionals met expertise in het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en het testen van aerospace systemen met focus op Electronic Warfare. Binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electromagnetic Warfare zoeken wij een ervaren en gedreven Teamleider om ons team te leiden en te inspireren. De afdeling is gericht op het ontwikkelen van innovatieve oplossingen voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) en heeft als doel om de Nederlandse en internationale lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie te ondersteunen. Als Teamleider binnen onze afdeling ASEW ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW. Je werkt nauw samen met de Afdelingsmanager en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken. In afstemming met de Afdelingsmanag

Dein Onboarding ist perfekt vorbereitet und nach einem ersten gemeinsamen Team-Lunch tauchst du direkt in die faszinierende Welt des E-Commerce ein – innovative und strategische E-Commerce und Digital Marketing Projekte mit führenden Marken aus den Bereichen FMCG, OTC, Fashion und Beauty. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen. De stageopdracht Tijdens deze hbo-stage ga je aan de slag met Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO). LOTO is een veiligheidsmethode waarbij machines en energiebronnen tijdens onderhoud of werkzaamheden veilig worden uitgeschakeld en vergrendeld. Zo wordt voorkomen dat een machine onverwacht wordt ingeschakeld terwijl eraan wordt gewerkt. Jij helpt Nedlin om deze werkwijze verder te ontwikkelen, te standaardiseren en praktisch toepasbaar te maken. Je onderzoekt de huidige LOTO-werkwijze en brengt risico’s, energiebronnen en isolatiepunten in kaart. Je ontwikkelt een uniforme LOTO-procedure en machine-specifieke LOTO-kaarten. Je brengt de benodigde materialen en hulpmiddelen in kaart. Je ontwikkelt instructie- en toolboxmateriaal voor medewerkers. Je stelt een praktisch implementatieadvies op om LOTO binnen Nedlin verder te borgen. Wat bieden wij? jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
